I do not have money to waste on chemical fertilizer for land that is not my own, and at my age I trust the old ways more than these new things. My children and grandchildren will help me clear this half-hectare and plant our own cassava cuttings, and we will spread what little goat manure we have to give the soil strength. We will pull the weeds by hand when the rains come, and I will pay some young men from the village to help with the heavy digging at harvest time because these old bones cannot manage that labor anymore.
